jobs.title: Platform
jobs.description: Skip to main content OPERATIONAL INTELLIGENCE See What Is Really Driving Your Operations CereBI builds a live model of your operations — connecting people, machines, inventory, orders, facilities, events, and KPIs — so you can detect risks, understand root causes, and act before problems become expensive. STARTING WITH SUPPLY CHAIN AND LOGISTICS. Request a Demo See How It Works WHAT CereBI builds a live operational model of how your business actually runs — connecting people, machines, inventory, orders, facilities, events, and KPIs so teams can detect risks, understand root causes, and act before problems become expensive. WHO IT'S FOR Enterprise operations, supply chain, logistics, warehouse, and manufacturing leaders. HOW IT WORKS Connects to ERP, WMS, TMS and operational systems; builds an entity model; detects bottlenecks, delays, shortages, underused assets, cost leakage, and root causes behind KPI drops; recommends the next best action. WHY IT'S DIFFERENT BI shows what happened. Dashboards visualize data. CereBI explains what is driving the business and what to do next. THE PROBLEM Your data is everywhere. The real problem is hidden between the systems. ERP knows orders. WMS knows inventory. TMS knows routes. Machines know status. Teams know what happens on the floor. But no single system explains how all of these affect each other. CereBI connects the dots so teams can understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what to do next. THE CEREBI MODEL A live model of your operational reality. CereBI maps your operation as connected entities: people, machines, inventory, orders, suppliers, facilities, routes, events, and KPIs. The model learns how these entities influence each other over time — helping you uncover the real drivers behind delays, bottlenecks, waste, and cost. THE MODEL Three worlds. One living model. People, machines, and processes — usually trapped in separate systems. CereBI models them as one connected supply-chain reality, so every decision sees the whole picture. ONE UNIFIED SPATIOTEMPORAL MODEL OF HOW YOUR OPERATION ACTUALLY BEHAVES. WHAT CEREBI DETECTS Risks and root causes — early. Bottlenecks before they cascade Delays and service-level risks Inventory gaps and shortages Underused assets and teams Cost leakage across operations Root causes behind KPI drops HOW IT WORKS From data to decision — in four steps. 01 Connect operational data ERP, WMS, TMS, machines, and the data around them — no rip-and-replace. 02 Build the entity model People, machines, inventory, orders, facilities, routes, events, KPIs. 03 Detect risks and root causes Surface bottlenecks, delays, cost leakage, and the drivers behind KPI drops. 04 Recommend the next best action Prescriptive steps, ranked by impact, with the reasoning made visible. BI shows what happened. Dashboards visualize data. CereBI explains what is driving the business — and what action should be taken. FREQUENTLY ASKED What teams ask about CereBI. What is CereBI? CereBI is building the AI model of how businesses actually behave. It is a living operational intelligence model that reveals the hidden relationships between people, machines, processes, resources, events, inventory, orders, suppliers, facilities, routes, decisions, and KPIs — turning fragmented operational data into a single model of performance, risk, and profit. How is CereBI different from BI, a dashboard, or GPT? BI describes what already happened. Dashboards show data. A general chatbot has no model of your operations. CereBI is a new category: a living model of how your business actually behaves, with reasoning, prediction, simulation, and prescriptive recommendations on top. Built for operations where everything affects everything. CereBI is designed for complex operational environments where people, machines, inventory, suppliers, facilities, processes, events, and KPIs constantly influence one another. Instead of looking at each system separately, CereBI builds a live model of how these entities interact — revealing hidden dependencies, root causes, risks, and opportunities for improvement. The result: teams can understand what is happening, why it is happening, what it affects, and what to do next. What does the CereBI model include? An entity graph of people, machines, inventory, orders, facilities, events, and KPIs; a digital twin of how the organization is actually running; spatiotemporal modeling; predictive AI; simulation; a recommendation engine; and a natural language interface. Does CereBI replace our ERP or existing systems? No. CereBI sits on top of existing ERP, WMS, TMS, BI, and external data — no rip-and-replace, no migration project. Is CereBI explainable? Yes. Every recommendation includes the reasoning chain — which entities, which relationships, which signals, which trade-offs. Your data describes what happened. CereBI learns why it happened — and shows its work. Who is CereBI built for? Enterprise operations and supply chain leaders running complex, multi-system environments where being late has measurable cost — and forward-looking leaders who want a real operational model of their business. Know what to fix before it costs you money. Request a Demo
